generic_sampling_rules.int_primary_key: Sequential integers starting at 1; never NULL; unique per table.
generic_sampling_rules.int_foreign_key: Sample from parent primary-key pool; include NULL rows (nullable FK) and rows referencing missing parent ids (unmatched join rows).
generic_sampling_rules.int_numeric: Uniform integer within observed min/max; include boundary values at listed literals and one step on each side.
generic_sampling_rules.real_numeric: Uniform real within observed min/max; include boundary values at listed literals and one step on each side.
generic_sampling_rules.text_short: Sample from observed distinct pool; include near-variants (case/whitespace changes) and duplicates to reach 20-50% duplicate share on DISTINCT columns.
generic_sampling_rules.text_nullable: Sample from observed pool; plant NULL rows at 5-30% share; never replace planted NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.year_real: Sample from observed year pool; integer-valued reals.
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: For every nullable column, at least one NULL row per instance; share follows compact database share (0% observed but still plant >=1 NULL for nullable columns per instruction 10).
